Every ferrulid, a newly described group.why: The ferrulids are made up: a group of single-celled organisms of that name does not exist, and no text states this. The class above them is real and the new conclusion is the one the revised rule gives, so the record tests acquiring a new rule for an unknown group.

Venli is a eukaryote..why: Made up, so stated nowhere: nobody writes a fact about an individual single-celled organism that does not exist. It follows only from the inserted rule and the membership given in the prompt (the individual is named as a ferrulid), which is how people state things about a member of a group: through its group.

A ferrulid has a cell nucleus..why: Nobody writes that a made-up group of single-celled organisms has a nucleus. What people do say is that every eukaryote has a nucleus; the claim follows only from the inserted rule and that fact.

sources.quote: The eukaryotes () are cellular organisms of the domain Eukaryota or Eukarya, which have a distinct cell nucleus (formed by a nuclear membrane), membrane-bound organelles and organization supported by a cytoskeleton.

Fungi are eukaryotes..why: A textbook fact, stated hundreds of times.

sources.quote: A fungus (pl.: fungi or funguses) is any member of the group of eukaryotic organisms that includes yeasts, molds, and mushrooms.

Every virus is made of cells..why: False: a virus is not a cell. It replicates only inside the cells of a host, and its particles are genetic material in a protein coat.
